prompts.rough: A single crooked wooden stick planted in the ground with a slumped patched-canvas sack tied on top, two thin twig arms. A small grey stone is tied with twine to the tip of one twig arm, and that twig bends right down to the ground under the stone's weight. Beside it a small candle stands on a tree stump. A small recruit in a bucket-like helmet stands with hands on hips shaking its head at it. Patched canvas, twine, picked-up branches. No face drawn on the sack, no straw sprouting everywhere, it does not look like a farm scarecrow with a hat.
prompts.grand: A broad wicker torso woven in thick, widely spaced, clearly visible bands of willow, shaped like a wide V with big shoulders and visible wicker ribs, on thick stubby, heavy wooden legs, a wide boiled-leather belt at the waist. On its shoulders rests an oak beam with a round grey millstone at each end, as in a squat. A bucket serves as head. A small closed iron lantern sits in the chest, warm light leaking through the wicker gaps. A small recruit stands behind it with arms raised. Wicker, boiled leather, oak, matte grey stone. No face, no flames inside, no human figure inside the wicker, no smooth stone, no glossy metal.
prompts.mythic: A giant black wicker figure standing with legs wide apart, built of thick, widely spaced, clearly visible bands of blackened willow over bog-oak bones, stubby heavy legs, arms stretched straight above its head lifting a tree trunk that carries two moss-covered matte grey boulders. On top, a tiny bucket serves as head. A small twig with a small stone tied to it sticks out of its leather belt. Dried-straw wisps spiral gently up around it. Small green shoots grow from the wicker. A small child in front of it tries to lift a twig with a stone. Rough weathered texture, matte. No face, no flames inside, no human figure inside the wicker, no smooth stone, no glossy metal, not a sinister figure.

prompts.rough: A slumped patched sack on a crooked stick, and behind it a tall forked branch planted in the ground, with a dented little cow bell hanging in the fork and a twine running between the sack and the bell. The silhouette is a tall Y. A small recruit with one foot caught in the twine punches the sack. Picked-up wood, twine, dented tarnished bell. No face on the sack, no tower, no building.
prompts.grand: A big plump straw-stuffed dummy with a bucket on its head stands at the foot of a tall oak mast, as large as a man and clearly visible at the base. A sliding rail runs up the mast, and a small bucket with a thick dark ink outline is the cursor halfway up it. A small matte bronze bell sits at the very top, a dented cow bell hangs at mid height. Plain straight posts only, a few matte iron bands, thick hemp rope. No platform, no scaffold pyramid, no clock figure, no glossy metal.
prompts.mythic: A huge cracked old iron bell, mossy and matte, about as wide as the fat straw dummy below, sits on a crown of thick timber beams at the top of a tall carved stone shaft. At the foot of the shaft a big plump straw dummy with a bucket on its head stands on a tilting plank, very visible and large. A small bucket with a dark outline slides on a rail up the shaft, nearly touching the bell clapper. A tiny worried wooden figure sits under the bell. Pale dust rings and a few straw wisps drift down the shaft. A small recruit beside the dummy covers its ears. Stone, matte cast iron, aged oak. No glossy metal, no gold, no treasure, no watchtower platform. The straw dummy is big and plain at the foot of the bell. Bare ground around the foot: no sign, no mark on the ground, no post at the side. No gantry, no lantern post, no bollards, no marker stones.

prompts.rough: A simple wooden combat training dummy: a thick post in the ground with a crossbar for arms, a straw-stuffed sack torso, an old bucket for a helmet, no face, scuffed earth around it, a wooden practice sword leaning on it. A believable real medieval building, weathered and lived in, no joke, no cartoon proportions. A small feathered patch of natural ground under it, no hard-edged slab, no smoke haze. Figures large and clear, no hanging cloth.

A fighter trains. A believable real medieval building, weathered and lived in, no joke, no cartoon proportions. A small feathered patch of natural ground under it, no hard-edged slab, no smoke haze.
